sanskrit:
भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम् ।
उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान् समवेतान्कुरूनिति॥ १-२५॥
iast:
bhīṣmadroṇapramukhataḥ sarveṣāṃ ca mahīkṣitām
uvāca pārtha paśyaitān samavetānkurūniti 1-25
translation: In front of Bhishma and Drona, and all the rulers of the earth, he said, O Partha, behold these Kurus gathered together.
